approval_boundary.statement: This technical evidence neither creates nor implies M2EntryGate PASS.

included: M1/M2 HUD, targeting, presenter, prefab, scene, and build containment
one fixed non-damaging static World pillar sprite and collider

preserved: M1 v001 animation atlas bytes, GUIDs, frame topology, and review evidence
M2Preproduction v001 sources, outputs, generation records, and GUIDs

deterministic_processing.result: Passed: exactly 5 outputs and index are deterministic
deterministic_processing.git_diff_check: Passed after canonical Unity-YAML trailing-whitespace normalization

m1_observed: Canvas matched both 1280x720 and 1920x1080 viewports and backing resolution.
Only Haste and Giant cards were physically visible; no Echo card or Echo presenter appeared.
Gameplay rendered nonblank with live combat and HUD.
m2_observed: Canvas matched both 1280x720 and 1920x1080 viewports and backing resolution.
Exactly one Echo card was visible beside Haste and Giant.
Keyboard 3 selected Echo and changed the card/help state to ECHO SELECTED.
Gameplay rendered nonblank with live combat and the approved v002 Echo icon.

animation_frame_samples.method: Chromium requestAnimationFrame counting during live WebGL gameplay
animation_frame_samples.note: Browser callback cadence is a responsiveness signal, not a Unity Profiler frame-time claim.

checks: Five production PNGs are 128x128 RGBA with binary alpha and index hash parity.
Unity import settings and pivots match the explicit contract.
M1 scene/prefabs contain no M2Production, M2Preproduction, EchoCard, EchoProjectilePresenter, or Echo visual dependency.
M2 scene/prefabs bind only the five approved v002 production sprites and no excluded keyword/resource.
Room_02 has no pillar; Room_03 has one static World-layer solid pillar with 1.2x1.8 collider and offset (0,0.28).
M1 animation atlas bytes and 944-frame imported topology remain authoritative and unchanged.

remaining: Judge the pillar source, 128px output, and gameplay-scale silhouette for permanent non-damaging cover readability.
Judge near/far depth overlap and collision-feel in Room_03 during hands-on play.
Judge the Echo icon, status, double-silhouette, and line telegraph at gameplay scale for semantic clarity and flicker-free presentation.
